The Sourcify-matched DebtToken implementation restricts mint() to BorrowerOperations, burn() to BorrowerOperations/TroveManager/StabilityPool and pool transfers to the named protocol callers. No additional native minter role exists in that implementation; upgrades can replace these restrictions.

controls.evidence: At Filecoin block 6458485 (2026-10-15T10:42:30Z), token, BorrowerOperations, TroveManager, PriceFeed and ProxyAdmin owners are this unchanged 2-of-3 Safe. getModulesPaginated() returns an empty list and terminal sentinel; guard storage is zero. Verified ProxyAdmin upgrade/upgradeAndCall are immediate onlyOwner calls without a queue or delay. getOwners() at that block and again at block 6458685 (2026-10-15T12:22:30Z) returns three 20-byte owner addresses with threshold 2; eth_getCode returns no EVM code for any of them. This establishes zero mandatory upgrade delay, not human signer independence or a complete execution certificate.

review.evidence: The 2026-10-15 review pins Filecoin block 6458485 (2026-10-15T10:42:30Z), hash 0xfe8adb3e783187f23605223eccddc6bbf0b33b6544a899b038144fa84298f703. EIP-1967 storage confirms implementation 0x584c1fa4ab299ae8f7154fce5b1bea7bddacfd0b and ProxyAdmin 0xa3122c3ee71cbdc9e60b47f502b015c2d82f5fcc. BorrowerOperations remains 0x1de3c2e21dd5af7e5109d2502d0d570d57a1abb0; token, ProxyAdmin, BorrowerOperations, TroveManager and PriceFeed ownership remains with the recorded 2-of-3 Safe, with unchanged owners, no enabled modules and zero guard. The verified ProxyAdmin has immediate onlyOwner upgrades and no mandatory delay. Sourcify again reports an executable-runtime match, not exact metadata equality. Pinned totalSupply and entire-system debt both equal 217964.428512163127719810 USDFC. The prior October 5 review recorded indexed lifetime counts of 575 mints, 3732 deduplicated burns, two upgrades and two ownership changes, with net issuance 186897978724044529018007 versus then-pinned supply 190455538808608777432105 raw units. Those historical figures are retained as prior evidence, not re-authenticated here or compared with today's supply. Today's public-RPC attempt to authenticate the first mint receipt at block 4807947 fails with requested block outside available upstream range. Current ownership and supply/debt equality do not resolve the lifetime issuance discrepancy or establish an incident verdict. The official lending upgrade history names order-book, Itayose, recovery and TokenVault changes on September 24, distinct from the USDFC oracle migration. It does not reconcile the exact core BorrowerOperations/Safe incident scope. Aggregate review remains unresolved and native authority remains unbounded-adverse.

unresolvedQuestions: The latest official update establishes still-paused lending/TokenVault remediation, not core USDFC BorrowerOperations/Safe incident status. Filtered lifetime indexer history is now recovered, but its net issuance does not match pinned totalSupply; GLIF cannot authenticate earliest mint or historical upgrade receipts and does not reproduce the latest indexed mint in its recent event query. Obtain an aligned authenticated historical issuance/upgrade census and exact affected-contract reconciliation before any core incident verdict.

Wave-2 source recovery by Sol curation campaign 2026-10-09 (W2L18Secured), observed 2026-10-09T11:42:48Z: the supplemental Dwellir helper rejects Filecoin because no endpoint is registered, before any state read. Official Filecoin RPC documentation says public endpoints guarantee only the latest 2000 blocks and identifies archival access as a separate provider prerequisite. This explains a historical-read capability limitation, not the issuance mismatch or either core control's incident state. The October 5 pin, review disposition and unresolved core census remain unchanged.

Wave-2 indexed-history recovery reviewed 2026-10-09T11:55:58Z by Sol curation campaign 2026-10-09 (W2L18Secured): Blockscout returns token-proxy initialization at block 4807452 (2025-03-21T04:06:00Z), implementation 0x68e1ece44233f55ab2cd155016bb515564d1851f, and upgrade at block 5282449 (2025-09-02T02:24:30Z), implementation 0x584c1fa4ab299ae8f7154fce5b1bea7bddacfd0b; the Upgraded filter has two rows and no next-page cursor. Transaction 0x41188a1f0e27a8f277461fc1c03f8f0849772468e88fed9c0f73b5fa0c1a108a is indexed as successful BorrowerOperations.openTrove at block 4807947 and contains zero-origin token Transfers. These are recovered explorer records, not raw archival receipts or proof of a complete issuance census. The retained net-issuance and pinned-supply figures differ by 3557560084564248414098 raw units; that difference is not an incident verdict. Exact-block eth_call POST attempts to the documented Lava and Chainup endpoints returned endpoint-discontinued and ring-balancer failures respectively, and Lava's replacement gateway requires sign-in. Obtain an archival receipt/state-capable source and reconcile all implementation intervals to the retained pin. No current token supply nested in historical explorer transaction responses is substituted for the pinned historical supply.
